services: # The Symfony CLI detects a mail catcher by container-internal port, and it
# recognizes only 1025 for SMTP together with 1080 or 8025 for the web UI.
# Mailtrap Local defaults to 3535 and 3550 and binds loopback only, so the
# listeners move here and the non-loopback bind is allowed explicitly.
# The service is not called "mailer", so the prefix is set explicitly to
# keep the MAILER_* variables Symfony Mailer expects.
